name: Meditation Tour to Cairo, Nile Cruise and Dahab
description: Join our Spiritual Meditation Tour to Cairo, Nile Cruise and Dahab, Experience Meditation tour to Cairo, Nile Cruise and Dahab, Amuse your soul by visiting King Chamber of Cheops, be ready for your Nile Cruise and discover all sites between Aswan and Luxor, relax and unleash your spirit at the amazing atmosphere at Dahab.
overview: Join our Spiritual Meditation Tour to Cairo, Nile Cruise and Dahab, Experience Meditation tour to Cairo, Nile Cruise and Dahab, Amuse your soul by visiting King Chamber of Cheops, be ready for your Nile Cruise and discover all sites between Aswan and Luxor, relax and unleash your spirit at the amazing atmosphere at Dahab.
highlights: High Dam, Philae temple and Kom Ombo
Visit Edfu Temple and Luxor Temple
Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, Karnak Temple
Meditation at King Chamber Of Giza Pyramids

itinerary.title: Arrive Cairo
itinerary.description: Once your flight landing at Cairo Airport, Ibis Egypt Tours representative will be waiting for you, holding a sign with your name, he will transfer you to Cairo domestic airport, catch your flight to Aswan, meet & assist at Aswan Airport, transfer to your Nile Cruise, and have dinner. Overnight on board.

itinerary.title: High Dam, Philae temple and Kom Ombo
itinerary.description: Breakfast on Board, AT 09:00 AM transfer to Visit the High Dam & Philae Temple, at 14:00 pm. Sail to Kom Mombo, Visit the Temple Shared by The Two Gods Sobek & Haroeris, Sail to Edfu, have lunch & dinner on board. Overnight on board your Cuise

itinerary.title: Visit Edfu Temple and Luxor Temple
itinerary.description: Breakfast on Board, AT 07:00 AM transfer to Visit Edfu Temple, Back To Cruise Sail towards Esna Lock, continue Sailing To Luxor, By Afternoon 16:00 transfer To Visit Luxor Temple. Then get back to your Cruise to have lunch and dinner on board. Overnight on board your Cuise

itinerary.title: Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, Karnak Temple
itinerary.description: Breakfast on Board, Visit the The West Bank, Visit the Neccropolis of Tehbes, Valley of kings, The Temple of Queen Hatshepsut and the Colossi of Memnon, Back To Cruise for Lunch, By 15:00 pm Visit Karnak Temple, Back To Cruise for Dinner On Board. (BLD) By Evening 22:00 pm. transfer to To Luxor Airport With Breakfast Box Fly To Cairo. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Luxor / Cairo - Visit Egyptian Museum
itinerary.description: Very early in the morning Arrive Cairo Airport Transfer to Hotel For Check-in, overnight in Cairo. At 10:00 am, Visit Cairo Museum, Lunch at local restaurant, Evening Enjoy Sound & Light Show, Dinner at local restaurant. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Meditation at King Chamber Of Giza Pyramids
itinerary.description: Early Morning Proceed for Meditation at Kings Chamber & Queens Chamber of Giza Pyramid, Packed Breakfast at Pyramid Complex, Free time for Photography at Pyramid Complex, Lunch at local Restaurant, transfer To Hotel For Relax after Meditation, By Evening Dinner at your Hotel. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Cairo / Dahab
itinerary.description: Breakfast at Hotel, then drive by air-conditioned vehicle from Cairo to Dahab, 595 KM, Lunch box. at your vehicle, arrive Dahab, Check-in, and have dinner. Overnight in Dahab

itinerary.title: Day at leisure in Dahab
itinerary.description: Breakfast at Hotel, then have the day at leisure in Dahab. Enjoy delicious dinner. Overnight in Dahab

itinerary.title: The Blue Hole Tour
itinerary.description: Early breakfast at your hotel, then transfer By Ibis Travel vehicle to the blue hole, at the end of your tour back to Dahab, then have dinner. Overnight in Dahab

itinerary.title: Dahab / Cairo
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel, then drive by air-conditioned vehicle from Dahab To Cairo, 595 KM., Lunch Box included, Arrive Cairo, check into your hotel, then have dinner. Overnight in Cairo

itinerary.title: Final departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel, transfer to Cairo International airport for final departure.

inclusions: Meet & assist at Cairo International Airport + transfer to hotel by air-conditioned vehicle
All Transfers & Sightseeing as per itinerary
04 nights Accommodation at 5 stars Nile Cruise (ASW- Luxor) on Full Board basis
03 Nights Accommodation at Cairo including breakfast
03 Nights Accommodation at Dahab including breakfast and dinner
All meals as per itinerary During the tour
All entrance fees Mentioned at the itinerary

02 Bottle of Mineral water per pax per day ON BUS During The TOUR ONLY
Assist and transfer to Cairo International airport on final departure.
Domestic flight Cairo / Aswan - Luxor / Cairo
